description: Returns recorded performance snapshots for a live deployment's bot, including total return, max drawdown, Sharpe ratio, and portfolio value over time. The hoursAgo parameter controls the lookback window (default 168 = 1 week, max 720 = 30 days). For current account performance use show_bot_activity first; this telemetry does not refresh broker valuations.
name: get_bot_performance
title: Fetch live performance metrics for a deployment
